title: Kreditozrouti / Service: api
description: http-api service api: status, requests, saturation and logs.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Every api container in $env is being scraped.

panels.title: Replicas
panels.description: Containers currently scraped.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the oldest running process started.

panels.title: Build
panels.description: Running image version per container.

targets.expr: max by (instance, version, commit) (app_build_info{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env"})

panels.title: Origin probe
panels.description: GET /api/health through Traefik with the public Host header.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests per second over the selected range.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of responses with a 5xx status over the selected range. 0 when there were no errors.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env", status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Requests within 1 s
panels.description: Exact share of requests completing within the 1 s SLO bound (an le bucket, not an interpolated percentile).

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Per status code.

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Aggregated across all routes: buckets are summed before the quantile is taken, never averaged afterwards. Values between bucket bounds are interpolated.

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Requests per latency bucket over time.

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Per route over the selected range: request rate, 5xx ratio and p95.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env", status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) / sum by (route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Edge requests
panels.description: Requests per second through Traefik over the selected range.

panels.title: Edge 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of 5xx responses served by Traefik (includes 502/504 when the container is unreachable).

targets.expr: (sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env", code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(increase(traefik_router_requests_total{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Edge requests by status
panels.description: Per HTTP status code, as seen by Traefik.

panels.title: Edge latency
panels.description: p50/p95 from Traefik router histograms. Precision is limited by the Traefik bucket configuration.

panels.title: Jobs by state
panels.description: bullmq_job_count per state (max across whichever services report it; they all read the same Redis counts). completed/failed depend on removeOnComplete/removeOnFail retention.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Jobs finished per minute by outcome, from worker events.

panels.title: Failure ratio
panels.description: Share of finished jobs that failed over the selected range. Old failures kept in the failed set do not count.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(worker_jobs_total{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env", queue=~"ScraperResponseQueue", outcome="failure"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(increase(worker_jobs_total{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env", queue=~"ScraperResponseQueue"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Waiting now
panels.description: Jobs waiting to be picked up.

panels.title: Job duration
panels.description: p50 and p95 processing time per job name.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (job_name, le) (rate(worker_job_duration_seconds_bucket{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env", queue=~"ScraperResponseQueue"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job_name, le) (rate(worker_job_duration_seconds_bucket{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env", queue=~"ScraperResponseQueue"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Last success
panels.description: Time since each job name last completed successfully (resets when the worker restarts).

targets.expr: time() - max by (job_name) (worker_last_success_timestamp_seconds{project="kreditozrouti", service="api", env="$env", queue=~"ScraperResponseQueue"})

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: Working set per container (cAdvisor), what the OOM killer compares against the limit.

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used per container (cAdvisor).

panels.title: Restarts and OOM kills
panels.description: Container starts and OOM events per container.

panels.title: Event loop lag p99
panels.description: Node.js event loop delay; sustained values above ~100 ms mean the process is CPU-bound.

panels.title: Heap
panels.description: V8 heap used and total per instance.

panels.title: GC time
panels.description: Seconds spent in garbage collection per second, by kind.

panels.title: Log volume by level
panels.description: Lines per interval. Lines without a JSON level are shown as "unknown".

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: ERROR and FATAL lines. Open a line for request_id links; use Explore > Logs Drilldown for patterns.
